title: [BUG]: Slow startup with multiple replicas — all N instances serialize on Alembic migration lock
reasoning:
## Summary

`make testing-up` starts **3 gateway replicas** (default `GATEWAY_REPLICAS=3`) simultaneously. Every replica calls `bootstrap_db()` → `alembic upgrade head` inside an advisory lock. Because the lock serializes migrations, startup time scales linearly with replica count: **3 replicas = 3× migration time before any instance is healthy.**

On PostgreSQL the instances queue correctly but wait needlessly. On SQLite the lock is silently broken in multi-container setups (each container has its own `/tmp`), so all migrations race concurrently against the same file.

---

## Steps to Reproduce

```bash
make testing-up          # starts 3 gateway replicas by default
docker compose logs -f gateway   # observe all three instances running alembic upgrade head
```

Expected: only one instance runs migrations; others wait or skip.
Actual: all three acquire or spin on the lock, delaying readiness by 2–3× migration time.
